note: Zone of the B23 workshop (R_road_03): La station-service, the side yard of the garage, camera in the yard facing the garage's stone side wall (same honey-cream stone, terracotta roof, spark-plug chimney). Landmark: the pale green canopy over three red vintage pumps with round clock tops. Feminine LEFT: lady in a green coat carrying a giant crystal perfume bottle (essence); cream delivery van with a cameo portrait on its door and a butterfly net on its roof (camionnette); dog in goggles astride the red motorbike (moto); baker on the little moped with a whale-painted tank and baguettes (mobylette). Masculine RIGHT: friendly ghost holding a red jerrycan of fuel (carburant); champion wrestler with a gold belt waving from the back of the blue lorry (camion); kangaroo in a necktie and trucker cap with a road map (routier, adj); silver petrol tanker with an oil-drop emblem and its driver cheering, arms up (pétrolier, adj); fox taxi driver with a tax bill by the yellow taxi (taxi). Exit: the glass-paned door in the wall -> back into the workshop R_road_03. Taxi roof sign blanked. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
